description: Assign N work items to D devices. Golden: floor(i*phi) % D. Round-robin: i % D.
interpretation: On a uniform discrete assignment, round-robin is exactly balanced by construction. Golden-angle assignment is close (CV < 0.03) but does not improve on perfect balance. The packing advantage of the golden angle appears in continuous expanding spaces (phyllotaxis), not in this modular discrete assignment.
next_construction: A continuous or expanding work domain (growing number of devices, non-uniform item sizes, or spatial embedding) is required before a packing advantage can appear.
